beliefs: The box uppercases the character at position 0 and leaves all other characters unchanged [E1, E2]
Leading whitespace is preserved, so '  hello' stays '  hello' and ' hello world ' stays ' hello world ' [E2]
Trailing whitespace is stripped, so 'hello  ' becomes 'Hello' and 'x   ' becomes 'X' [E2]
A lone space or all-space string becomes empty, consistent with trailing-strip leaving nothing [E1, E2]
A tab at position 0 is not uppercased and is preserved, so '\thello' stays '\thello' [E2]
Digits, symbols, and already-uppercase letters are unchanged [E1]
notes: Replaced strip-then-capitalize with rstrip-then-uppercase-position-0, since leading whitespace is preserved but trailing whitespace is removed; a lone space becomes empty via rstrip.
